units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL HTTP tests for a bounded, authorization-filtered Issue-subtree diagnostic projection containing parent/blocker/wake edges, stall explanations and explicit truncation metadata.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> Issue diagnostics route -> Issue graph/authorization/read-model services -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL Issues, projects, relations, Runs, wake requests, comments and activity.
units.keyDataModels: Company default responsible user; Issue parent/project/status/assignee/responsible user; blocker relation; low-trust Run authorization policy; sanitized wake edge; node diagnosis; caps/truncation and omitted-unauthorized count.
units.lifecycle: Authorize root read -> traverse bounded descendants and blockers -> authorize each node under actor/Run scope -> attach bounded sanitized wake/activity evidence -> derive stall explanation -> report omitted/truncated uncertainty without returning raw operational payloads.
units.testAssessment: All 5 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Intended coverage proves one blocked graph, quiet singleton, node cap, mention-scoped hidden child and cross-tenant 404. Missing are cycles, depth cap, blocker/wake/activity caps, ordering, large-graph query counts, stale data/versioning, board roles, allowed-field minimization and machine-readable diagnosis stability.
units.designRationale: Give operators and constrained Agents a read-only explanation for stalled subtrees without exposing raw wake payloads, errors or unauthorized nodes, and make bounded/incomplete results explicit.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs trustworthy, permission-aware explanations of why work is blocked and who must act, without leaking hidden projects, sensitive data, Connector payloads or evidence outside the viewer's contract.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT bounded graph projection, per-node authorization, explicit uncertainty and raw-field redaction. Emit versioned structured DiagnosisCode/Cause/RequiredActor/ResponsibilityObligation plus localized presentation separately; scope by data contracts and evidence labels; use snapshot/asOf version, cycle-safe traversal and query budgets; make omitted-count disclosure policy-configurable and route recommended action to the accountable human.
units.responsibilityConflict: The diagnosis explains topology and wake activity but does not prove who is accountable, what authorization or approval is missing, or whether evidence is current. Human-readable strings are not a stable responsibility contract, and an omitted-node count can still reveal hidden structure.
units.securityFindings: HIGH authorization side-channel risk: omittedUnauthorizedNodeCount reveals hidden graph cardinality by design. HIGH stability gap: diagnosis/likelyReason are English strings rather than versioned codes and parameters. HIGH performance gap: caps exist but no cycle, depth or query-count evidence proves safe traversal. HIGH verification gap: all real-database/HTTP tests skipped. MEDIUM minimization gap: only raw wake fields are explicitly checked, not every allowed Issue/Agent field. POSITIVE: tenant 404, per-node low-trust filtering, bounded output and secret-marker assertions are unusually strong diagnostic-safety primitives.
